Bananas Royale
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 12:51am

Ingredients




4 bananas, sliced in half (lengthwise)
1/2 cup butter
1 tablespoon rum
1 teaspoon cinnamon

Preparation

1 Saute bananas in butter, rum mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Serve over coffee ice cream or vanilla ice cream. 2 NOTE: Add 1 teaspoon coffee to butter, rum mixture if coffee ice cream is unavailable.
